title: FcGPT generative model designs antibody Fc variants with programmed receptor binding
summary: A library of more than 400 million Fc variants was screened against eight Fc receptors by yeast display and deep sequencing, and the data trained FcGPT, a generative protein language model that designs Fc variants with user-defined receptor binding profiles. Experimental testing of 2,000 designs across 19 objectives yielded variants matching prescribed profiles, with success rates of 5% to 100%, including variants that selectively engage FcgammaR3A over FcgammaR3B or the reverse. Preprint; protein-engineering result reported from the abstract only.
